title: Introduction to the tinkr package
text: basic example. read “example1.md”, change headers 3 headers 1, save back md. xml2 objects passed reference, manipulating require reassignment.
code: library("magrittr") library("tinkr") # From Markdown to XML path <- system.file("extdata", "example1.md", package = "tinkr") # Level 3 header example: cat(tail(readLines(path, 40)), sep = "\n") #> ### Getting a list of 50 species from occurrence data #>  #> For more details about the following code, refer to the [previous post #> of the series](https://ropensci.org/blog/2018/08/21/birds-radolfzell/). #> The single difference is our adding a step to keep only data for the #> most recent years. ex1  <- tinkr::yarn$new(path) # transform level 3 headers into level 1 headers ex1$body %>%   xml2::xml_find_all(xpath = ".//md:heading[@level='3']", ex1$ns) %>%    xml2::xml_set_attr("level", 1)  # Back to Markdown tmp <- tempfile(fileext = "md") ex1$write(tmp) # Level three headers are now Level one: cat(tail(readLines(tmp, 40)), sep = "\n") #> # Getting a list of 50 species from occurrence data #>  #> For more details about the following code, refer to the [previous post #> of the series](https://ropensci.org/blog/2018/08/21/birds-radolfzell/). #> The single difference is our adding a step to keep only data for the #> most recent years. unlink(tmp)

text: yarn$show() method now gains lines parameter, allows subset output lines text. warning produced stylesheet supplied place lines. yarn$append_md() yarn$prepend_md() methods allow add new markdown specific places document using XPath expressions. to_md_vec() takes xml node nodelist returns character vector markdown produced. show_list(), show_block(), show_censor() show markdown content node, nodelist, list nodes without needing print entire document. yarn$md_vec() new method generate character vector markdown elements query. convenience method uses xml2::xml_find_all() to_md_vec() background. get_protected() function (yarn method) return nodes protected way {tinkr} via one protect_ family functions. Adopting pattern preferred using md:text[@asis='true'] attribute names may change future (@zkamvar, #111; reviewed: 1) Block math now include delimiters softbreaks protection (issue/review: #113, 1; implemented: #111, @zkamvar) Frontmatter TOML JSON now preserved . yaml field replaced (softly deprecated) field called frontmatter. new field called frontmatter_format (“YAML”, “TOML”, “JSON”) contains format frontmatter. (issue: #126, 1) New protect_fences() function add fence='true' attribute fences Pandoc fenced divs allow parsing XML sending external APIs. New $protect_fences() method implements protect_fences() yarn objects
